scope: Research-only candidate geometry artifacts under data/research/candidate-trails/hallandsleden/geometry. These are not runtime app data.

policy.canonical: Exact official GPX track/segment coordinates converted to GeoJSON. Use this for provenance and normalization.
policy.drawReady: Canonical geometry with only long intra-segment official jumps linearly densified for renderer compatibility. Official GPX track/segment breaks are preserved. Draw-ready coordinates added by densification are approximate and must not be treated as field-verified trail turns.
